description: This file declares functions related to DNS mode management within a WAN manager component. It includes licensing information, include guards, and external C linkage, and references external dependencies.

methods.name: dns_mode_set
methods.description: Sets the DNS mode for the specified WAN object. Takes a pointer to amxd_object_t as parameter.

methods.name: dns_mode_unset
methods.description: Unsets or resets the DNS mode. No parameters.
